title: Implement deterministic D&D SRD rules-pack importer
description:
Implement a deterministic importer for the selected D&D SRD corpus.

The importer should transform approved source material into canonical Loreweaver rules records with provenance and license metadata. It should not rely on model reasoning for authoritative rules content.
acceptance_criteria:
- Importer runs from source material to generated records.
- Generated records validate against kind-specific schemas.
- Importer output is deterministic across repeated runs.
- Records include source/provenance/license linkage.
- Importer is documented for future regeneration.
notes:
Vertical slice landed in PR #92 (commit 5ffe62c): importer foundation (vendor location, pdfjs-dist+pdfkit deps, deterministic pipeline, CLI, typecheck:scripts), real spell stat-block parser (incl. class-list cross-reference), 35 tests across parseSpells/emit/pipeline. Scope guardrail per ADR 0007 + session direction: only spell records are emitted; manifest description lists included kinds explicitly so generated pack cannot pose as reference-complete. Default --out is gitignored scratch path; canonical pack location untouched.
